TOBIAS VENKATARAMAN
Backend Engineer
Columbus, OH | tobias.venkataraman@example.com | (555) 014-2273 | github.com/tvenkat-example

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with about 6 years of experience building high-throughput services in Go and Kotlin on PostgreSQL and Kafka. Tech lead for Project Tern, the carrier-settlement rewrite at Larkspur Freight. Comfortable owning a service from design doc through launch and on-call.

EXPERIENCE

Larkspur Freight | Software Engineer II, Backend | Columbus, OH | Mar 2023 - Present
- Tech lead for Project Tern, a rewrite of the carrier-settlement service from a Rails monolith into three Go services; coordinated a working group of 4 engineers and 1 QA analyst over 7 months.
- Cut p95 latency of the rate-quote API from 820 ms to 190 ms by replacing N+1 PostgreSQL queries with a batched loader and a 90-second Redis cache keyed by lane ID.
- Designed Dockhand, a Kafka event pipeline that processes about 2.3 million shipment status events per day, using a transactional outbox table to avoid duplicate writes.
- Reduced monthly settlement mismatches from 312 to 41 with a nightly reconciliation job that compares carrier invoices against booked loads.
- Partitioned the 1.9-billion-row load_events table by month in PostgreSQL, cutting nightly vacuum time from 4 hours to 35 minutes.
- Wrote the team's first set of 14 incident runbooks; member of a 6-person on-call rotation.

Quillfeather Health | Software Engineer | Cincinnati, OH | Aug 2021 - Feb 2023
- Built the appointment-reminder service in Kotlin (Spring Boot) that sent 11 million SMS and email reminders in 2022; the no-show rate at the 9 pilot clinics fell from 18.4% to 12.9%.
- Migrated 38 cron scripts into Metronome, a single Temporal-based scheduler, removing a class of double-send bugs.
- Introduced Pact contract tests between 5 internal services, cutting integration-environment breakages from roughly 9 per month to 2.
- Implemented field-level encryption for patient phone numbers using envelope keys in AWS KMS.

Brindlecap Labs | Junior Developer | Cincinnati, OH | Aug 2020 - Jul 2021
- Maintained a Python/Django inventory tool used by 60 independent bookstores; added a CSV import that replaced a manual 3-hour weekly task.
- Wrote the product's first automated test suite, taking line coverage from 0% to 71%.
- Handled customer-support escalations one day per week.

SIDE PROJECT
Sparrowhawk (open source, maintainer since 2022)
- Go library for idempotency keys backed by PostgreSQL advisory locks; about 640 GitHub stars.
- Supports configurable key expiry and a replay-safe response cache; test suite runs against PostgreSQL 13 through 16.

EDUCATION
Ohio Valley Polytechnic University | B.S. Computer Science, Minor in Mathematics | May 2020
- Senior capstone: a route-planning simulator for municipal snowplow fleets.

SKILLS
Languages: Go, Kotlin, Python, SQL, some TypeScript
Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, AWS SQS
Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, RDS, KMS), Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions, Datadog
Practices: design docs, transactional outbox, idempotency, contract testing, on-call and runbooks

jd.text:
SENIOR BACKEND ENGINEER, PAYMENTS & LEDGER
Tallowmarket, Inc. | Denver, CO

ABOUT TALLOWMARKET
Tallowmarket is a B2B marketplace where independent restaurants buy directly from regional farms and ranches. Our Payments & Ledger group moves about $1.1B a year through escrowed payouts to more than 6,500 growers. We are a team of 140 people, about 55 of them in engineering. Our backend is Go on PostgreSQL, with Kafka between services and Temporal for long-running payment workflows.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Own services in the money path: escrow holds, split payouts to growers, refunds and chargebacks.
- Design and evolve Harrow, our double-entry ledger built on PostgreSQL, as volume grows from 400,000 to a projected 1.5 million ledger entries per day.
- Improve the reliability of the nightly settlement batch that runs at 02:00 Mountain Time and must finish before banks open.
- Lead technical design reviews and mentor mid-level engineers on the team.
- Join the on-call rotation, currently one week in six.
- Partner with Finance and Risk on reconciliation and audit requirements.

WHAT YOU BRING
- 5+ years of professional backend experience in Go, Java or Kotlin.
- Deep PostgreSQL knowledge: indexing, locking, isolation levels, and safe online migrations.
- Experience with event-driven systems (Kafka, Kinesis or similar) and idempotent processing.
- A track record of leading multi-engineer projects from design doc to launch.
- Clear written communication; we make most decisions in design docs.

NICE TO HAVE
- Prior work on a double-entry ledger or a payments platform.
- Experience reducing PCI DSS scope.
- Stripe Connect or Adyen for Platforms integration experience.
- Experience with Temporal or another durable workflow engine.

WORK ARRANGEMENT
Hybrid: in our Denver LoDo office Tuesday through Thursday; Monday and Friday are flexible. Relocation assistance is available for candidates moving to the Denver metro area.

COMPENSATION
Base salary band: $172,000 - $208,000 USD, plus equity and a 6% 401(k) match. This role is leveled at L5 (Senior).

INTERVIEW PROCESS
Recruiter screen (30 minutes), a 60-minute ledger design exercise, a Go coding session, and a values conversation with our Director of Engineering, Imani Castellanos.

Tallowmarket is an equal opportunity employer.

Distinctive resume needles: Project Tern, Dockhand, Metronome, Sparrowhawk, 820 ms to 190 ms, 2.3 million events per day, 312 to 41 mismatches, 18.4% to 12.9% no-show rate, 14 incident runbooks, Ohio Valley Polytechnic University. Distinctive JD needles: Harrow ledger, $172,000 - $208,000, L5, Tuesday through Thursday in Denver LoDo, 02:00 Mountain Time settlement batch, one week in six on-call, Imani Castellanos. Candidate lives in Columbus, OH; role is hybrid in Denver.

DASHIELL MARROW
Platform / Infrastructure Engineer
Tacoma, WA | dash.marrow@example.com | (555) 019-8840 | github.com/dmarrow-example

SUMMARY
Infrastructure-focused engineer with about 1.5 years of full-time experience after a B.S. in Computer Engineering. Works mainly with Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Python and Rust. Interested in SLOs, alert quality, and removing manual toil. Certified Kubernetes Administrator.

EXPERIENCE

Hollowbrook Data | Infrastructure Engineer (Contract) | Seattle, WA | Jun 2026 - Present
- Moved 23 Terraform root modules from local state files to a remote S3 backend with DynamoDB state locking.
- Wrote Kestrel, a Python CLI that checks Terraform plans against 17 Open Policy Agent rules before merge; it blocked 9 public-bucket changes in its first 10 weeks.
- Right-sized node pools on two EKS clusters, lowering compute spend from about $41,300 to $29,800 per month.
- Replaced hand-edited IAM policies with 11 reusable Terraform modules reviewed through pull requests.

Cindervale Systems | Site Reliability Engineer I | Tacoma, WA | Jul 2025 - Jan 2026
- Member of a 5-person SRE team supporting 140 microservices on three GKE clusters.
- Built Grafana SLO dashboards for the 12 tier-1 services; pages fell from about 260 to 70 per month after moving to multi-window burn-rate alerts.
- Automated TLS certificate rotation with cert-manager, retiring a 47-step wiki runbook.
- Wrote Lanternfish, a Rust sidecar that exports per-pod DNS lookup latency to Prometheus; it showed that 31% of p99 latency on the checkout path came from DNS resolution.
- Ran a quarterly game day for GKE node-pool upgrades with 3 service teams, using a scripted drain-and-cordon checklist.
- Shadowed the on-call rotation from August 2025; primary on-call from November 2025.

Orrin Telematics | Platform Engineering Intern | Spokane, WA | May 2024 - Aug 2024
- Containerized 6 legacy Java services and wrote Helm charts for each.
- Cut CI time for the main monorepo from 34 minutes to 13 minutes with Buildkite build caching.
- Demoed ephemeral preview environments to about 80 engineers at the internship showcase.

SIDE PROJECT
Tidepool Homelab
- 4-node Raspberry Pi k3s cluster managed through Flux GitOps.
- Hosts a self-hosted Matrix chat server; measured 99.2% uptime over 180 days with Uptime Kuma.
- Loki and Grafana for logs; all manifests public on GitHub.

EDUCATION
Puget Cascade University | B.S. Computer Engineering | May 2025
- Capstone: Brine, a distributed key-value store in Rust using Raft consensus (team of 3).
- Teaching assistant, CPE 342 Operating Systems, two semesters.
- Relevant coursework: Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Distributed Systems.

CERTIFICATIONS
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), 2025

SKILLS
Infrastructure: Kubernetes (GKE, EKS, k3s), Helm, Terraform, Flux, cert-manager
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Uptime Kuma
Languages: Python, Rust, Bash, some Java
Cloud: GCP, AWS
Other: Linux networking, DNS, TLS, Buildkite, GitHub Actions, Open Policy Agent

jd.text:
PLATFORM RELIABILITY ENGINEER (EARLY CAREER)
Nimbuscrest Cloud | Portland, OR

ABOUT NIMBUSCREST
Nimbuscrest Cloud runs managed PostgreSQL and S3-compatible object storage for about 9,000 customers across four regions: Portland, Frankfurt, Singapore and Sao Paulo. We operate our own fleet of roughly 3,000 bare-metal hosts rather than renting from a hyperscaler, and we publish a 99.95% monthly availability target for managed databases.

THE TEAM
Fleet Reliability is 7 engineers reporting to Engineering Manager Oyelaran Fitch. We own host provisioning, the Kubernetes control planes that run our storage services, and the incident process for the whole company.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Operate and harden the Kubernetes control planes behind our storage and database services.
- Automate host provisioning and firmware updates across the bare-metal fleet.
- Define and review SLOs with service teams, and tune alerting so pages are actionable.
- Respond to incidents as part of a follow-the-sun rotation and write blameless postmortems.
- Build capacity forecasts for disk and network in each region.
- Retire manual runbooks by turning them into tested automation.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- 1-3 years in SRE, infrastructure, or platform engineering (internships count).
- Hands-on Kubernetes operations experience.
- Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python or Rust.
- Solid understanding of Linux internals and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP, TLS).
- Infrastructure as code with Terraform or Pulumi.
- Willingness to participate in on-call after a ramp-up period.

NICE TO HAVE
- eBPF-based debugging or observability tooling.
- Ceph or other distributed storage operations.
- Running PostgreSQL in production.
- PXE-based bare-metal provisioning.
- Experience with Prometheus and multi-window burn-rate alerting.

WORK ARRANGEMENT
Hybrid: two days a week in the Portland Pearl District office. Occasional travel (about twice a year) to the Frankfurt region for data-center work.

HOW WE HIRE
A recruiter conversation, a 90-minute take-home in which you debug a broken three-node cluster, a systems deep-dive with two engineers, and a conversation with Oyelaran.

Nimbuscrest Cloud welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.
